subject: Supplier onboarding: invoice submission preferences, compact template & migration plan
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@northbridge-ops.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding — invoice submission options and template question

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the onboarding packet — we’re excited to start supplying GPU accessories to Redwood. Our AP team has two quick questions before we complete your onboarding form:

1) Can you confirm the preferred invoice intake channel? We currently send invoices via:
   - Portal upload (SFTP/portal CSV)
   - Email to billing@redwood.com with CSV attached

2) If portal is preferred, what is the minimal column set you require? Our current ERP exports a compact CSV with: invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, line_amount, tax_amount, total, supplier_vat_id. We want to avoid generating a wider extract if not needed.

I’ve attached our blank onboarding form and a one-line sample invoice export for reference (invoice_sample.csv).

Also: if we switch channels later (portal -> email), what subject token or file naming convention do you rely on so invoices route automatically?

Appreciate any guidance — I can loop in our AP lead if helpful.

Thanks,
Linda Park\Vendor Ops | Northbridge Logistics
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, invoice_sample.csv

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Linda Park <linda@northbridge-ops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice submission options and template question

Hi Linda — great to meet you and thanks for sending the samples. Quick answers below, plus we’ll confirm a migration plan if you need to change channels later.

Preferred intake channel
- Portal upload is our recommended default for new suppliers: it gives the fastest processing and better PO-match reliability.
- Email is supported as a fallback but requires a strict subject token and header fields to avoid manual routing.

Minimal CSV schema (portal)
- Must-haves: invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_description, line_quantity, line_unit_price, currency, line_amount, total_amount.
- Optional but helpful: tax_amount, supplier_vat_id, shipping_amount.

Fallback email rules
- If using email, subject must include: [RBWD-INVOICE] and the PO number. Example: [RBWD-INVOICE] PO-12345
- Attachments should be a single CSV or a single PDF; multiple attachments increase manual review time.

Migration plan
- If you start with email and move to portal later we can bulk-reprocess up to 90 days of invoices if you provide a zipped CSV export named NB_bulk_export_YYYYMMDD.zip and attach a mapping file. I’ll coordinate the mapping with our AP team.

I’m looping in Marissa (AP intake) and Karthik (vendor onboarding) to confirm the exact column header names and the onboarding form fields. Marissa — can you confirm the final required header names and whether we can accept supplier_vat_id as optional? Karthik — any PO-stamping rules we should share with the vendor?

Best,
Jasmine Liu\Account Manager, Strategic Partners | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Linda Park <linda@northbridge-ops.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice submission options and template question

Thanks Jasmine / Linda — confirming from AP intake: we prefer portal and the exact header names listed below. If the vendor can provide a compact CSV using these columns we’ll accept it without additional transformation.

Required (exact header text):
- invoice_number
- invoice_date
- po_number
- line_description
- line_quantity
- line_unit_price
- currency
- line_amount
- total_amount

Optional (ok to omit):
- tax_amount
- supplier_vat_id
- shipping_amount

Email fallback requirements (AP intake rules):
- Subject token: [RBWD-INVOICE] mandatory
- File name: single CSV named RBWD_invoice_<vendor_shortname>_<YYYYMMDD>.csv (example: RBWD_invoice_NB_20260607.csv)
- If a PDF is submitted instead, it must contain a visible PO number on the first page; OCR may fail if scanned poorly.

Attachments included: I exported a compact example (compact_template_v1.csv) showing how multiple lines are represented (one row per line). I also attached the onboarding spreadsheet we ask vendors to complete — the supplier_vat_id column remains optional.

Karthik — for PO stamping: we automatically stamp inbound invoices to match POs if the po_number field matches an open PO. If the vendor does not include PO numbers we route to manual review which delays payment. Recommend telling your AP to include the PO on every invoice line.

Next steps:
- Linda: please confirm you can produce the compact CSV with those header names.
- Once confirmed, we’ll send a short test (3 invoices) to the portal to validate mapping and timing.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole\Sr. AP Analyst | Redwood Inference
Attachments: compact_template_v1.csv

From: Linda Park <linda@northbridge-ops.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice submission options and template question

Hi Marissa / Jasmine,

Thanks — we can match the required headers and will start with the portal. I’ve completed the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx and attached it here. We’ll:

- Upload three test invoices to the portal tomorrow (compact CSV following the exact header text you listed).
- If anything fails we’ll fall back to the email pattern with the subject token and file name you specified.

I’ll share the portal test IDs once uploaded. Appreciate the clear guidance — this helps our ERP export pipeline stay lean.

Best,
Linda Park\Vendor Ops | Northbridge Logistics
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, invoice_sample.csv
